title: Partition Equal Subset Sum
contract: For nonnegative values with bounded total sum, decide whether all values can be split into two subsets of equal sum; empty subsets are allowed.
optimal: int total=Arrays.stream(a).sum();if((total&1)!=0)return false;int target=total/2;boolean[] dp=new boolean[target+1];dp[0]=true;for(int x:a){for(int sum=target;sum>=x;sum--)dp[sum]|=dp[sum-x];emit("Use each item at most once","value",x,"reachable sums",dp);}return dp[target];
reasoning: An equal partition exists exactly when one subset sums to half the total; an odd total is impossible.
A boolean knapsack table records attainable sums using processed elements.
Iterate sums downward to prevent taking the same element twice. The table is pseudo-polynomial, so a huge numeric total requires a different strategy such as meet in the middle.
complexity: O(nS), O(S), S half the total
